reader.requirement: ACCEPT identifier-2 FROM DAY-OF-WEEK must deliver, as if from an unsigned one-digit integer item, the current weekday numbered 1 = Monday through 7 = Sunday, stored into identifier-2 by the MOVE rules (GR6).

edition-consulted.switches: refuses DATE YYYYMMDD / DAY YYYYDDD (accept-four-digit-year-2002, COBOL0815) and END-ACCEPT (end-accept-2002, COBOL0816) below 2002; the bare DATE / DAY / DAY-OF-WEEK / TIME forms pass through unchanged
the rows accept-four-digit-year-2002 and end-accept-2002 (introduced 2002) that the pass checks
DATE, DAY, DAY-OF-WEEK and TIME are reserved at 85, 2002, 2014 and 2023 alike, so a user item of those names is refused (COBOL0901)

reader.edition-search: grep for Edition|CobolVersion|Dialect|Construct in AcceptDisplayBinder.cs, AcceptDisplayEmitter.cs, BoundAccept.cs, AcceptSource.cs and MoveTable16.cs: the binder's ctx.Edition is only the diagnostic sink; the emitter, the conceptual-digit table and the runtime clock reads consult no edition
reader.witnesses-cover: part: g85_f12_01 checks the one-digit length and Monday = 1 relative to DATE on the run day only; Sunday = 7, and non-numeric, edited, scaled, signed, group, JUSTIFIED and 9(18) receivers are not exercised there

probes.printed: pin 2026-11-15 (Sunday): DOW=7; pin 2026-11-16 (Monday): DOW=1; pin 1988-12-31 and 2000-01-01 (Saturday): DOW=6

probes.expected: one-digit unsigned integer 4 moved by the MOVE rules into each receiver

probes.printed: ODO=[3  4] (W-T(3) of an ODO table) RM=[****4**861] (W-RM(5:1) FROM DAY-OF-WEEK)
probes.expected: the digit stored in the subscripted ODO element and in the one-character reference-modified slice

probes.printed: error COBOL0818: ACCEPT receiver 'W-A' ... a numeric or numeric-edited sending operand does not move to an alphabetic receiver
probes.expected: refused: an integer sender does not move to an alphabetic item

probes.printed: error COBOL0901: 'DAY-OF-WEEK' is a reserved word in COBOL-85
probes.expected: refused: DAY-OF-WEEK is a reserved conceptual item, not described in the program

probes.printed: error COBOL0815 ... ACCEPT FROM DAY YYYYDDD
error COBOL0816: END-ACCEPT (explicit scope terminator) requires COBOL-2002
probes.expected: refused at 85 (no END-ACCEPT in the 1985 format)

probes.printed: error COBOL2269: unexpected 'ON'. ACCEPT ON EXCEPTION ... specifies FROM
probes.expected: refused: format 2 has no exception phrase

citations.check: OK  §1985:VI.6.5.4 GR10  (6.5.4 General Rules)  the text is in GR10 ["the value 1 represents Monday"]

reader.notes: AcceptSource.DayOfWeek remaps .NET's Sunday=0 numbering by ((d+6) mod 7)+1, and the binder materializes a one-digit unsigned display integer that MoveBinder stores into the receiver. Pinned-clock probes give 1 on a Monday, 7 on a Sunday, 4 on Thursday 1986-12-25, and every receiver class takes the digit by the MOVE rules; the witness g85_f12_01 also MATCHES at 85. The same path runs at --std 2023 with identical output.
reader.at-2023: acc1.cob at --std 2023 prints the same lines

refuter.evidence: Read §1985:VI.6.5.4 GR6-GR10 and the format 2 diagram (bare DATE/DAY/DAY-OF-WEEK/TIME, no END-ACCEPT, no exception phrase); read AcceptSource.DayOfWeek (((int)DayOfWeek+6)%7+1) and SystemClock (one pinned clock read per ACCEPT). Probe racc1.cob at --std 85, WISEOWL_COBOL_CLOCK=1986-12-25T14:41 (Thursday): VP PIC V9 =[.0], NE Z9.99- =[ 4.00 ], ST S9 TRAILING =+4, W-E(W-D) with W-D just ACCEPTed FROM DAY-OF-WEEK lands in element 4; all by the MOVE rules. Class c refusals at 85: rx11 (DAY-OF-WEEK ON EXCEPTION) COBOL2269, rx7 END-ACCEPT COBOL0816, rx1/rx3/rx4/rx10 GnuCOBOL forms (COMMAND-LINE, CENTURY-DATE, YYYYMMDD, MICROSECOND-TIME) COBOL0817, rx2 FROM ENVIRONMENT and rx13 FROM EXCEPTION STATUS COBOL5506, rx12 USER NAME COBOL0307; class b: rx5 condition-name receiver COBOL1639, rx6 FUNCTION CURRENT-DATE receiver COBOL5506, rx9 two receivers COBOL5506. cite.py: OK §1985:VI.6.5.4 GR10 ["the value 1 represents Monday"]. No arm found that differs from the reader's account.
